indicators.name: Suspicious LoLBin Execution from Non-Standard Parent
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious LoLBin Execution from Non-Standard Parent
id: f1a2b3c4-d5e6-4f7a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects unusual execution of system utilities like certutil, bitsadmin, and wmic from non-standard parent processes, which could be indicative of malware generated by tools like MessiahGPT.
references:
  - https://cybersecuritynews.com/shell-investigating-data-breach
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-15
tags:
  - attack.t1218
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
  filter:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\services.exe'
      - '\svchost.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects unusual combinations of system utilities like certutil, bitsadmin, and wmic, which could be indicative of malware generated by tools like MessiahGPT.

indicators.name: Unsigned Executable from Temporary Directory
indicators.pattern:
title: Unsigned Executable from Temporary Directory
id: a2b3c4d5-e6f7-4a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of an unsigned executable from a common temporary directory. This is a common behavior for malware, and the volume is expected to increase with AI-generated malware tools like MessiahGPT.
references:
  - https://cybersecuritynews.com/shell-investigating-data-breach
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-15
tags:
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|contains:
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - 'C:\Temp\'
    Signed: false
  condition: selection
indicators.description: A behavioral detection hint from the article suggests hunting for unsigned executables running from temporary directories, a common malware behavior expected to increase with tools like MessiahGPT.

indicators.name: DNS Query to Suspicious TLD
indicators.pattern:
title: DNS Query to Suspicious TLD
id: b3c4d5e6-f7a8-4b9c-0d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to suspicious top-level domains (TLDs) often associated with newly registered or malicious domains. This is a behavioral hint for hunting activity related to tools like MessiahGPT.
references:
  - https://cybersecuritynews.com/shell-investigating-data-breach
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-15
tags:
  - attack.t1568
  - attack.command_and_control
level: low
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith:
      - '.xyz'
      - '.top'
      - '.online'
      - '.club'
      - '.live'
      - '.buzz'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: A behavioral detection hint from the article suggests monitoring for beacons to newly registered domains, as AI-generated malware will still require C2 infrastructure.
